npm Phishing Campaign Targets Prettier Tooling

Target: eslint-config-prettier
Repository: https://github.com/prettier/eslint-config-prettier
Date: 2025-07-18 to 2025-07-19 (1 day)
Attribution: Third Party
Component: Library
Language: JavaScript
Cause: Social Engineering
Motive: Remote Code Execution
Transitive: true
Impact Type: Code Execution
User Impact: 5000000
Domain: npmjs.com (package host)
Artifact Type: source archive
Insertion Phase: distribution

Synopsis

A phishing campaign targeting npm maintainers using a typosquatted domain (npnjs.com) compromised ESLint and Prettier tooling packages. The attackers published malicious versions directly to npm that loaded a Windows-specific DLL (node-gyp.dll) via rundll32 for potential RCE, bypassing GitHub source code changes.

Compromised Versions

  • 8.10.1
  • 9.1.1
  • 10.1.6
  • 10.1.7
